response.justification: The candidate is a versatile and experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong distributed systems and infrastructure exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks anywhere near 8 years of C++ programming experience (only a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or production cloud architecture experience, and his skills/background (JS/TypeScript, DLang, Node.js, web/mobile) are misaligned with the C++-heavy, compute-platform focus of this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated technical leadership via mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
Experience with distributed, high-throughput microservices infrastructure (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months), far short of the 8-year requirement
No evident large-scale cloud compute platform or production cloud architecture experience
Career shows breadth over depth in any single required technology stack (web/mobile/DLang/TypeScript rather than C++/cloud infra)

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform/production cloud architecture experience
Strong leadership, mentoring, and distributed systems background
